text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A distinctive rowan tree. At its roots, a
large hollow." Yes, this has
got to be the
Lonely River!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A large hollow... You mean that over
there? Ah, sorry to keep asking
questions!
I actually tried to find out what would be
waiting for us
here before coming!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't find the movie anywhere, so
we'll have to rely on you
for everything,
I'm afraid.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Oh yeah... I'm the only one who knows the
story. I-I've got to take
the lead!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-so what we'll try and do now is cross the
stepping stone path over
the river and get
the gemstone from the pedestal.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! But I don't see any stepping stones
in the river, or a pedestal!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's a trick to it! If you flip the switch,
the stones and the pedestal
will rise out
from the water!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And that switch is right here in the hollow
of this rowan tree... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? The switch is supposed to be
here... Instead there's
writing... "The
longest beard in the forest"...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, if the trial was exactly the same as
the movie, people would
be able to cheat,
so they changed it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! True, I hadn't thought of that. Ummm,
ummm... let's just try
searching around!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I can't see it. What even is "the
longest beard in the forest"
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! El, look at that! It's a long, thick ivy
branch! It goes all the way
from the top of
the tree down to the river!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It looks strong enough to make into a
swing. Tannhauser, go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Roger! I'll just get comfy in here and
swiiing! Swing-a-linga-ding!
Woohoo! This
is fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...What was that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Is this the switch?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble, rumble!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look over there! Stones have risen
out from the river!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Someone must've found the switch. So...
once the stones come out,
what do we do
again?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! W-we have to act fast, so I'll g-go
on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Calm down, Rob Roy! What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if it's the same as in Rhodonite, then the stepping stones will only stay for a few minutes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So there's a time limit. In that case, why
don't we flip the switch and
start again—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
We can't! "Under the moonlight, the magic
replenishes." Which means
it only works
once per day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, we don't wanna miss our chance!
Okay, I'm confident in my
speed!

text_block_list.name: Dober & Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-wait!
Ah! T-Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be quick but careful! Hop, step,
jump! Whoa, it's slippery!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-will she be okay? The rocks will sink if
she doesn't get back in
time, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You're actually supposed to cross the
steps while holding on to a
long vine for
safety, but I haven't seen it anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there was a vine? Oh well, don't
worry! I'm almost at the stone—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah?! My step is sinking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gah! What?! I-I'm being swept away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Machitan, swooping in!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I think I flipped the switch by
accident—sorry! Hey, are you holding
on,
Taiki? Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hold on to the vine and I'll take you to
shore, my princess! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! You're my hero!

text_block_list.name: Dober & Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ph...phew!
